notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes: [p]I want to share some updates on the game’s development. I’ve been focusing on improving the game’s foundation so I can deliver smoother updates and more exciting features in the future. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][b]Codebase Improvements[/b] – The game’s code has been restructured to allow for a more flexible development process, making it easier to introduce new features.[/p][p][b]Save System Overhaul[/b] – I’ve completely reworked the save system to make it more reliable and future-proof.[/p][p][b]Preparing for Upcoming Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game now supports adding [b]new product types[/b] in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Initial groundwork has been laid for a [b]shop system[/b], where players will eventually be able to purchase different types of stock.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update focuses on behind-the-scenes improvements to make future updates faster and more seamless. Thank you all for your patience and support.[/p]
